title: Ramadan 2027: Expected Dates and the Islamic Calendar for 2027
seoTitle: Ramadan 2027 Dates: When Does Ramadan Start? (Expected)
excerpt: When Ramadan 2027 is expected to begin, when Eid al-Fitr may fall, and other key Islamic dates in 2027.
description: Ramadan 2027 is expected to begin around Monday 8 February 2027. Expected dates for Eid al-Fitr, Eid al-Adha and other key Islamic dates in 2027.
body:
Ramadan 2027 (1448 AH) is expected to begin on or around **Monday 8 February 2027**, with the first night of Taraweeh prayers on the evening of Sunday 7 February. The exact date depends on the sighting of the new moon, so it can differ by a day where you live.

## Why the date isn't fixed

The Islamic (Hijri) calendar follows the moon. Each month begins with the new crescent moon and lasts 29 or 30 days, so the Islamic year is about 354 days long. That's around 11 days shorter than the Gregorian year, which is why Ramadan arrives about 11 days earlier each year.

Many communities start Ramadan and Eid after the crescent moon is sighted. Others follow a calculated calendar. The dates below come from the Umm al-Qura calendar used in Saudi Arabia, so treat them as a guide and follow your local mosque or Islamic authority.

## Key Islamic dates in 2027 (expected)

- **Start of Rajab 1448:** around Thursday 10 December 2026
- **First day of Ramadan 1448:** around Monday 8 February 2027
- **The 27th night of Ramadan:** around the night before Saturday 6 March 2027. Laylat al-Qadr is sought in the last ten nights, especially the odd nights.
- **Eid al-Fitr (1 Shawwal 1448):** around Tuesday 9 March 2027
- **Day of Arafah (9 Dhu al-Hijjah):** around Saturday 15 May 2027
- **Eid al-Adha (10 Dhu al-Hijjah):** around Sunday 16 May 2027
- **Islamic New Year (1 Muharram 1449):** around Sunday 6 June 2027
- **Ashura (10 Muharram 1449):** around Tuesday 15 June 2027

Remember that Islamic days begin at sunset. The evening before each date above is already the start of that day in the Islamic calendar.

## How long will Ramadan 2027 last?

Ramadan lasts 29 or 30 days, depending on when the Shawwal moon is sighted. On the calculated calendar, Ramadan 1448 has 29 days, with Eid al-Fitr on Tuesday 9 March 2027.

## Preparing for Ramadan

- Start easing into earlier mornings in Sha'ban
- Plan a daily Quran reading goal, for example one juz a day to finish in the month
- Check your local prayer times for Suhoor and Iftar

Convert any date with the free [Hijri date converter](/tools/hijri-date-converter/), check [today's prayer times](/tools/prayer-times/) for your location, and reflect on the [Ayah of the day](/ilmai/ayah/).
